Panel_Empty: Copy something — it will show up here.
Panel_EmptyPinboard: Right-click a card and choose “Pin to” to add it here.
Pinboard_DeleteBody: All items in this pinboard will be deleted. This can't be undone.
Edit_RichNotice: Formatting will be removed when you save.
Notify_Running: ClipNest is running in the background. Press {0} to open it.
Notify_HotkeyFailed: {0} is already used by another app. Pick another shortcut in Settings.
Notify_PasteBlocked: The app runs as administrator, so ClipNest can't paste into it. Press Ctrl+V.
Notify_PasteFailed: Couldn't switch back to the app. Press Ctrl+V to paste.
Notify_DbRecovered: The history database was damaged and has been reset. The old file is kept in the data folder.
Settings_LanguageDesc: Takes effect the next time ClipNest starts.
Settings_Startup: Launch ClipNest when you sign in
Settings_RetentionDesc: Items in pinboards are always kept.
Settings_RetentionConfirmBody: Items older than {0} will be deleted right away. This can't be undone.
Settings_PlainTextDesc: Tip: hold Shift while pasting to drop formatting once.
Settings_LinkTitlesDesc: Downloads the title of web pages you copy links to.
Settings_OcrDesc: Search images by the text they contain. Recognition runs on this device.
Settings_ClearDesc: Deletes everything except items in pinboards.
Settings_ClearConfirmBody: {0} items will be deleted. Items in pinboards are kept. This can't be undone.
Settings_HotkeyHint: Click, then press the new shortcut. Esc cancels.
Settings_HotkeyTaken: One of the shortcuts is already used by another app.
Settings_KeysHelp:
Enter or double-click — paste
Shift+Enter — paste as plain text
Ctrl+1…9 — paste item 1…9 (add Shift for plain text)
Type anything — search
← → — move · Ctrl+← → — switch pinboard
Space — preview · Ctrl+E — edit · Ctrl+R — rename · Ctrl+P — pin
Ctrl+C — copy without pasting · Delete — delete · Ctrl+Z — undo
Esc — close
Settings_IgnoreConfidentialDesc: Skips passwords and other content that apps mark as private.
Settings_HideFromCaptureDesc: ClipNest windows won't appear in screenshots, recordings or screen sharing.
Settings_PauseRecordingDesc: While paused, nothing you copy is saved.
Settings_IgnoredAppsDesc: Copies made in these apps are never recorded.
Settings_AboutDesc: A clipboard manager for Windows, inspired by Paste for Mac. Everything you copy is kept on this device.
Settings_PrivacyNote: ClipNest stores your history only on this PC and never sends it anywhere. Link titles are fetched from the linked website when that option is on.
Stack_NewestFirst: Pasting newest first — click to paste in copy order
Stack_OldestFirst: Pasting in copy order — click to paste newest first
Stack_EmptyHint: Copy several things one after another. Then press {0} repeatedly to paste them in order.
Stack_NextHint: The highlighted item is pasted with the next {0}.
Onboarding_Subtitle: Everything you copy is saved, searchable and one keystroke away.
Onboarding_Hotkey: Press this anywhere to open your clipboard history. ClipNest keeps running in the notification area.
Settings_DetectSecrets: Skip passwords and keys by content
Settings_DetectSecretsDesc: Private keys, API tokens (GitHub, AWS, OpenAI…) and JWTs are not recorded, even when the app doesn't mark them.
Settings_RecordImagesDesc: Turn off to keep screenshots and copied pictures out of history.
Settings_BackupDesc: Export history, pinboards and images to a .zip file, or restore one.
Settings_ImportConfirmBody: Your current history will be replaced (a copy of it is kept in the data folder). ClipNest restarts to finish.
Settings_ImportInvalid: This file is not a ClipNest backup.
